This unique ship... wait a second, let's look at that card again! This ship isn't unique. Instead, the diamond-shaped symbol before the title indicates that the Trade Federation Droid [[Control (Dark) (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] Ship is limited to one copy per system. Previously, these markings have mostly appeared on locations. Indeed, this is the first ship to use this icon.

The numbers on Trade Federation Droid [[Control (Dark) (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] Ship compare favorably with the non-unique [[Trade Federation Battleship]]. Its power and forfeit are reduced by 1, but this reduction is balanced by the increased armor, ability, and the reduced deploy cost.

The Droid [[Control (Dark) (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] Ship is crucial for the proper functioning of the Trade Federation's droid starfighters, reflected by both the power penalty the droid starfighters suffer when not present with this important ship as well as the deploy bonus they receive when deploying to the same system. Needless to say, it is recommended that your droid starfighters stay close to this ship.

Deploy the [[Laser Cannon Battery]] aboard to not only hit your opponent's ships, but cause a 1 Force loss to direct damage when you do so. Add [[Imperial Artillery]] to add another Force loss, either during your [[Control (Dark) (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] phase or after successfully hitting a ship with the Battery (or both, since [[Imperial Artillery]] can be used twice per turn!). Deploy the [[Neimoidian Pilot]] aboard (for free at [[Naboo (Dark){{!}}Naboo]]) and activate an extra Force when doing so. [[Tey How]] can also make herself useful here, giving you the ability to reduce Force lost to drains at nearby parsecs.

Combos:

Power 12 plus 2 battle destiny. Add a few more pilots and/or ships to maintain control of a system while [[Tey How]] reduces your Force loss to drains at systems within 2 parsecs.
